insights.one_liner: NextNovate is a Zoetermeer IT consultancy and Google Cloud Premier Partner focused on helping organisations adopt cloud and digital workplace tools.

culture.text: A small company: LinkedIn lists 43 employees; it was founded in 2016 and is based in Zoetermeer.
It calls itself 'the human side of cloud' and works with Google Cloud, Okta and Meta as a partner.
Staff come from schools like Amsterdam and Utrecht universities of applied sciences, TU Delft and The Hague University, mostly in IT and business.
Its 2 open jobs here are both entry-level IT and cloud roles in Zoetermeer.

open.text: NextNovate is not an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch and both show pay.
